text_blocks.snippet: No, the COVID-19 booster shot is not the same as the initial vaccine series.
The booster shot is an additional dose of the COVID-19 vaccine that is given after the completion of the primary vaccination series (two doses for most vaccines). The booster is designed to:

list.snippet: Boost immunity levels that may have waned over time
Provide broader protection against emerging variants of the virus
